segments.name: Alternative Credit
segments.description: Earns income and preserves capital by investing in debt, direct lending, CLOs and specialty finance such as factoring.
segments.evidence: Alternative Credit - focused on income generation and capital preservation through investment in debt and income-generating securities, direct lending, CLOs, and specialty finance businesses including Factoring, Asset Based Lending and Healthcare

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.description: Full-service, end-to-end real estate platform for the industrial outdoor storage sector, combining investment expertise and turnkey execution.
segments.evidence: Real Estate - full service, end-to-end real estate platform combining investment expertise and turnkey execution capabilities for IOS sector

revenueModel.text: The investment vehicles GECC and Monomoy UpREIT pay management, property management, incentive and administration fees under investment management agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: GECM and MCRE, our wholly-owned subsidiaries, earn revenue through investment management agreements with each investment vehicle that provide for management fees, property management fees, incentive fees and/or administration fees.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Company realigned its reportable segments into Alternative Credit and Real Estate, recasting prior periods.
changes.evidence: As a result of this change in segment reporting, the Company retrospectively recast prior period results, by segment, to conform to the current period presentation.
